name: Aru Douwa Kara no Dasshutsu ~Akazukin Hen~
original_name: ある童話からの脱出～赤ずきん編～
source:
There lived a curious little girl who wore a red hooded cape. 
One day she took a basket of delicious wine and bread to her grandmother's cottage. 

However, she entered the cottage to a grisly scene. 
Her grandmother had been eaten by a wolf which now slept in her bed. 

"Oh dear...! My grandmother has been eaten by a wolf which now sleeps in her bed...!" 

She tried to flee from the cottage and call the huntsman. 
But by bad luck or perhaps tampering, the door would not open. 

Little red riding hood was trapped. 

"What to do, what to do... That's right, my grandmother told me of a secret passage. 
Surely I can get out that way." 

Search the room and escape the cottage before the wolf wakes up! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121185.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
住着一个好奇的小女孩，她穿着红色的连帽斗篷。
有一天，她带着一篮子美味的酒和面包来到了祖母的小屋。

然而，当她进入小屋时，看到了可怕的一幕。
她的祖母被一只狼吃掉了，狼现在睡在她的床上。

“天哪……！我的祖母被狼吃掉了，现在它睡在她的床上……！” 

她试图逃离小屋并打电话给猎人。
但由于运气不好或者可能被篡改，门打不开。

小红帽被困住了。

“怎么办，怎么办……对了，奶奶告诉我了一条秘密通道。
我当然可以从那条路出去。” 

在狼醒来之前搜索房间并逃离小屋！
